name: PruneExpiredWorkingCopies
transaction_boundary: one short LLD-01 UnitOfWork per maximum 100 rows
authoritative_reads: ui_working_copies where expires_at_utc <= server now ordered expires_at_utc,working_copy_id
guards: server clock supplied by trusted runtime, never client body
idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1; absent/already-pruned rows are naturally skipped within the selected due batch
receipt_order: select/revalidate due rows -> insert receipt -> delete selected due rows -> metadata-only audit/result -> commit
mutations: delete only selected still-expired ui_working_copies rows
post_commit_work: if more_due, durable/housekeeping caller may enqueue another bounded invocation
